description: List Twitch's top categories (games/topics) ranked by live viewer count, from Twitch's internal GraphQL (the Browse page's Categories ranking). Returns each category's name, slug (usable as twitch/get-feed's category parameter), genre tags, live viewer count, box art URL, and page URL. Fetches the first page in a single request up to the limit (max 100); partial=true when fewer categories than requested are returned. No login required; runs via Node, no browser.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of categories to return (1-100, default 20). Fetches the first page in one request; partial=true when fewer than limit are returned. Twitch's after-cursor pagination triggers an integrity check, so the command does not paginate beyond the first page.
